Le maillot domicile 2026-27 de l'US Thionville Lusitanos, conçu par Kappa, est sorti le 5 août 2026. Sa base bleu clair ... arbore un col ras-du-cou blanc ainsi que des finitions blanches assorties sur le bord des manches. Un motif graphique subtil et complexe, dans un ton de bleu plus foncé, représentant des monuments locaux, orne la partie inférieure du maillot. [Button: Plus d'informations]

The FC Versailles L’Audacieux jersey presents a bold gold design enhanced by a navy vertical stripe bordered in white. T... his central stripe showcases three powerful symbols: the iconic Kappa Omini logo, a radiant sun emblem referencing Louis XIV—the “Sun King”—and a fleur-de-lis, a timeless marker of Versailles’ royal identity. Drawing inspiration from retro football aesthetics and contemporary street style, L’Audacieux delivers a modern reinterpretation of classic codes. Navy Kappa taping along the shoulders adds a distinct 90s touch, blending tradition with urban flair. Designed for those who live football beyond the pitch, this jersey projects a strong visual identity. Its graphic composition unites heritage, culture and style, creating a striking expression of Versailles’ bold character. [Button: More]
